# Permian Local

> Web studio in Odessa, Texas. We build fixed-price, bilingual (English/Spanish) websites for small businesses in Odessa and Midland, TX.

- Starter website: 1 page, fixed price quoted with the free mockup, live in 7 days.
- Business website: up to 5 pages, fixed price quoted with the free mockup, live in 10 days.
- Care plan: monthly plan (small changes, backups, domain and email help).
- Free homepage mockup in 48 hours: https://permianlocalseo.com/#mockup
